record.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との接続または一般化可能なLLM推論効率効果が弱く、具体的な追加検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 HongTu moves GNN training vertex data to CPU and uses partitioning, recomputation/caching and deduplicated transfers; it reports lower communication and speedups for billion-scale graph training. This is a GNN training system rather than LLM inference/offload, so transfer to the linked LLM training-memory family is indirect.
record.title: HongTu: Scalable Full-Graph GNN Training on Multiple GPUs
